description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PaginatedTest' that tests the functionality of the 'Paginated' class in the Goteo\Util\Pagination namespace. It creates mock data, initializes Paginated objects, and performs assertions to verify pagination logic.

classes.name: PaginatedTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'Paginated' class functionality, including instantiation, page size, and total pages calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a mock page object with 25 entries for use in tests.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Paginated class and asserts its type.

methods.name: testRs
methods.description: Verifies that the getRs method returns the correct number of items in the result set.

methods.name: testPage
methods.description: Tests pagination calculations such as page size and total number of pages for different page size inputs.
